name: gui_graph_folded_edits
description: GL-5e, on the fixture (Blank makes neither): the Frame Plan's tab is never brought forward. (c) The folded node of a pass the project authored (a managed fragment, passes/authoring/pass-<id>.json) is picked on the Graph and its Delete pass -- the entry its right-click lists, fired by name -- is the Frame Plan's Delete: remove_authored_pass takes the fragment and its file away. (d) face_tint, a pass of the rendering section in the cube capture's family, is picked: its detail column has LP-4b's View field, and choosing face 2 there is the Frame Plan's View menu's edit (view_select). Each step reads the document and the picture. Typed: nothing.
